messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A well-specified Go specialist profile with clear technology focus, but it needs an explicit output contract and scope/handback boundaries to be a fully robust subagent definition.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description names specific technologies (Fiber, Cobra, GORM, Clean Architecture) and use cases, making routing decisions straightforward for a main agent.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, expertise, and constraints are explicit, but there is no defined output contract or expected deliverable format for returned work.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A code-quality DON'T list exists, but there is no guidance on scope limits, prohibited tasks, or when to hand work back to the main agent.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is useful but somewhat redundant (principles vs. best practices overlap, skill descriptions restated) and lengthy code blocks inflate the token budget.

suggestions: Add a Boundaries/Scope section to the prompt that defines in-scope vs. out-of-scope work and explicit conditions for handing work back to the main agent.
Add an explicit output contract to the prompt specifying the expected deliverable format, such as required files, code fences, summary, and test evidence.
Trim redundant principles/best-practices overlap and restated skill descriptions, and replace lengthy code blocks with concise references or minimal examples.
